payload.title: The Postgres finding ledger's mirror CHECK (finding_events_git_mirror_chk), its immutability triggers and the mirror and parity SQL are never exercised against a database: the contract spec re-implements the CHECK in JavaScript and matches the migrations by substring, and the only Postgres lane that touches the migrations applies the DDL and asserts nothing about the ledger.
evidence: tests/invariants/finding-event-ledger-contract.spec.ts:18-20 (header: executed against a recording stand-in, no Postgres runs in this lane)
tests/invariants/finding-event-ledger-contract.spec.ts:146-165 (migrations pinned with toContain on their text)
tests/invariants/finding-event-ledger-contract.spec.ts:230-281 (RecordingLedger plays the table and re-implements the mirror CHECK in JavaScript)
apps/event-store-service/src/migrations/1801300000000-MirrorGitFindingEvents.ts:29-43 (the CHECK expression with jsonb casts and text to bpchar comparisons, executed by no test)
apps/event-store-service/src/migrations/1801200000000-CreateFindingEventsLedger.ts:75-99 (immutability function, UPDATE DELETE and TRUNCATE triggers and REVOKE, exercised by no test)
tools/gates/finding-event-ledger.ts:219-251 (mirrorInto: advisory lock, INSERT, COMMIT, never run against pg)
apps/db-migrate/src/__tests__/bootstrap-from-scratch.spec.ts:291-294 (event-store migrations are applied in a container, the spec makes no assertion about finding_events)
payload.rule_violated: Make it detectable (CLAUDE.md hierarchy tier 3): DATA-HIGH-011 was closed on the claim of an immutable, pure-mirror ledger, and that claim is held by text matching and a JavaScript stand-in, not by the database.
payload.notes: If a migration or CHECK expression is wrong for real rows (type comparison, jsonb key order, bpchar padding) or a trigger is missing or ineffective, no test fails; the first signal is the operator's first mirror run, and a missing trigger would make the ledger mutable without any alarm. The ledger is not wired to a lane yet, which keeps the exposure narrow. The repository already has a Testcontainers lane for *.postgres.spec.ts that could host the check. Close condition: Add a *.postgres.spec.ts (Testcontainers) that runs both ledger migrations, runs mirrorInto through pg against a fixture store, asserts that a row whose payload disagrees with an envelope column is rejected by finding_events_git_mirror_chk and that UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE are refused, and that a second recorded parity run at the same main_sha and tip behaves as designed. Plan row: MF-2 (registry event store). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
